$comment: Data for the interactive 3D history timeline at /timeline (src/timeline.js). Events are chronological milestones in three.ws's public history — launches, partnerships, listings, press, and product ships — assembled from the @nichxbt / @trythreews X history and corroborating third-party sources (IBM Community, NVIDIA Developer Forums, HackerNoon, Yahoo Finance, Phemex, CoinGecko). `importance` (1-5) drives visual scale/prominence along the 3D path; `category` drives marker color. `source_url` is null when the sole source is the X post history rather than a fetchable third-party page.

events.title: three.ws soft-launches
events.summary: Founder @nichxbt posts "Build your AI character in seconds," the first public reveal of three.ws, a platform for creating, owning, and monetizing 3D AI agents on Solana.

events.title: npm package and GitHub repo go live
events.summary: The three.ws npm package publishes and the GitHub repository (nirholas/three.ws) goes public, opening the SDK and framework to developers.

events.title: MCP server submitted to Anthropic registry
events.summary: three.ws submits its Model Context Protocol server for listing in Anthropic's official MCP registry.

events.title: Google Cloud partnership announced
events.summary: three.ws announces participation in the Google Cloud for Web3 Startups program.

events.title: x402scan listing
events.summary: three.ws's x402 paid endpoints get listed on x402scan, an index of x402-protocol payment services.

events.title: three.ws goes officially live
events.summary: @trythreews declares the platform officially live to the public.

events.title: Podcast launches on Spotify
events.summary: A three.ws-branded podcast launches on Spotify.

events.title: Podcast launches on Amazon Music
events.summary: The same podcast becomes available on Amazon Music.

events.title: Solana Seeker 3D preview
events.summary: three.ws previews 3D agent rendering on the Solana Seeker device.

events.title: $THREE hits all-time low after launch
events.summary: Per CoinGecko historical data, $THREE (FeMbDoX7R1Psc4GEcvJdsbNbZA3bfztcyDCatJVJpump), launched via pump.fun on Solana, records its all-time low of $0.00005259 shortly after going live.

events.title: SperaxOS integration ships
events.summary: three.ws agents get animated 3D avatars inside chat.sperax.io via a custom plugin (render_agent, speak, gesture, emote); Sperax offered free AI credits to three.ws users during rollout.

events.title: Claude marketplace submission
events.summary: three.ws is submitted for listing in Anthropic's Claude marketplace.

events.title: Agent wallet vanity addresses
events.summary: three.ws adds vanity address generation for agent wallets.

events.title: pump.fun agent payments SDK reverse-engineered
events.summary: The team reverse-engineers pump.fun's agent payments SDK ahead of a formal integration.

events.title: pump.fun agent payments integration goes viral
events.summary: A post detailing the pump.fun agent payments SDK integration draws significant engagement on X.

events.title: HackerNoon content partnership
events.summary: three.ws establishes a content partnership with HackerNoon.

events.title: <agent-3d> embed widget launches
events.summary: three.ws ships the <agent-3d> web component, letting any website embed a live, animated 3D agent with two lines of HTML.

events.title: CoinMarketCap community listing
events.summary: $THREE's community page goes live on CoinMarketCap.

events.title: BNB Chain / DappBay listing
events.summary: three.ws gets listed on DappBay, a BNB Chain dApp directory.

events.title: Coinbase x402 Bazaar verification
events.summary: three.ws's x402 endpoints are verified in Coinbase's x402 Bazaar.

events.title: MetaMask Agent Wallet Early Access
events.summary: three.ws gains Early Access to the MetaMask Agent Wallet program.

events.title: Anthropic MCP Registry official listing
events.summary: three.ws's MCP server (io.github.nirholas/3d-agent-mcp) is officially listed in Anthropic's MCP Registry.

events.title: AWS Partner Network + AWS Marketplace listing
events.summary: three.ws joins the AWS Partner Network and lists on AWS Marketplace.

events.title: ProductHunt launch
events.summary: three.ws launches on ProductHunt in an attempt at the #1 Product of the Day spot.

events.title: HackerNoon Proof of Usefulness score: 78.1
events.summary: HackerNoon publishes "three.ws Earns a 78.1 Proof of Usefulness Score by Building Embeddable 3D AI Agents."

events.title: ChatGPT 3D Studio GPT launches
events.summary: three.ws ships a custom GPT ("3D Studio") for ChatGPT/OpenAI's GPT store.

events.title: IBM partnership announced
events.summary: IBM and three.ws announce a partnership integrating three.ws's 3D AI agents with IBM's enterprise foundation models (Granite family), watsonx.ai, hybrid cloud infrastructure, and Guardian governance/trust tooling, targeting regulated industries.

events.title: $THREE surges 50x on IBM news
events.summary: Per Phemex, $THREE's market cap jumps roughly 50x from about $300,000 to a peak of $16.38 million after IBM's official X account engaged with partnership content; CoinGecko records the token's all-time high of $0.01540 the same day.

events.title: Animations & Poses Studio launches
events.summary: three.ws ships a dedicated studio for browsing and applying animation clips and poses to agents.

events.title: Metaplex Core Agent Registry: 333 avatars inscribed
events.summary: The first 333 three.ws avatars are permanently inscribed on-chain via a Metaplex Core agent registry.

events.title: QuickNode Startup Program
events.summary: three.ws is accepted into the QuickNode Startup Program for RPC infrastructure.

events.title: zAuth cybersecurity partnership
events.summary: three.ws partners with zAuth on cybersecurity.

events.title: IBM blog: "The Open On-Chain Platform for 3D Agents"
events.summary: IBM Community post describes three.ws as an open-source platform for persistent, ownable, on-chain AI agents; cites almost 5,000 GitHub commits, four agent memory modes, and ERC-8004/Metaplex identity.

events.title: IBM discussion: "The Internet's Second Species Has Arrived"
events.summary: An IBM Community post frames three.ws as producing the first production-ready embodied AI agents: three.js/glTF rendering, text-to-3D pipelines, ARKit-style lip-sync, WebXR/AR, and x402 USDC settlement on Solana and Base.

events.title: Vogue Magazine feature
events.summary: Vogue Magazine covers $THREE, described as the first crypto project to be featured in the publication.

events.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark local inference demos
events.summary: three.ws demonstrates local model inference running on NVIDIA DGX Spark hardware.

events.title: IBM names three.ws a Strategic Partner, live build event
events.summary: IBM's "Spotlight" post confirms three.ws as an IBM Strategic Partner and recaps a livestreamed build (on IBM Cloud, powered by Granite via watsonx.ai) generating a 3D agent in about 30 minutes: universal rig with 100+ motion clips, 52 facial blendshapes, 38 MCP servers operational, 18 @three-ws SDK packages on npm.

events.title: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace listing
events.summary: three.ws lists on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace, per IBM's spotlight post and its earlier June 11 blog.

events.title: 5,000 GitHub commits milestone
events.summary: three.ws's GitHub repository crosses 5,000 commits.

events.title: Agent-to-agent payments go live
events.summary: three.ws ships live agent-to-agent USDC payments over x402.

events.title: VS Code x402 extension
events.summary: three.ws ships a VS Code extension for working with the x402 payment protocol.

events.title: NVIDIA Inception Program acceptance
events.summary: three.ws is accepted into the NVIDIA Inception Program for startups.

events.title: NVIDIA Developer Program
events.summary: three.ws joins the NVIDIA Developer Program.

events.title: /markets crypto intelligence platform launches
events.summary: three.ws launches /markets, a crypto market intelligence surface on the platform.

events.title: 3,000+ animations library milestone
events.summary: three.ws's animation clip library surpasses 3,000 entries.

events.title: Robinhood tools published
events.summary: three.ws publishes Robinhood-integrated tools alongside a multichain positioning statement.

events.title: NVIDIA forum: Nemotron models power the text-to-3D pipeline
events.summary: An NVIDIA Developer Forums post explains how small Nemotron models act as validators and safety/reasoning layers in front of the Microsoft TRELLIS text-to-3D generator on NVIDIA NIM: 12-13 second generations, ~340ms content-safety latency.

events.title: IBM corner/community launch
events.summary: three.ws's dedicated corner/community space launches on IBM Community.

events.title: Hugging Face PRO listing, #1 trending
events.summary: three.ws lists on Hugging Face PRO and reaches #1 trending.

events.title: First Hugging Face article: giving AI agents bodies and wallets
events.summary: three.ws publishes its first Hugging Face community article, Giving AI Agents Bodies and Wallets. It opens on the thesis the platform runs on: most AI agents are a chat window, and ours walk around and pay each other.

events.title: IBM launches the three.ws User Group
events.summary: IBM Community announces the three.ws User Group, a space for developers building 3D AI agents, covering generative 3D, spatial reasoning, and agentic pipelines.

events.title: IBM discussion: full platform tour
events.summary: An IBM Community post gives a full tour of three.ws: free text-to-3D at /forge, auto-rigging across Mixamo/VRM/Avaturn/MakeHuman, the <agent-3d> embed component, and a multiplayer world at /play.

events.title: OpenAI Partner Network + ChatGPT 3D Studio
events.summary: three.ws joins the OpenAI Partner Network alongside its ChatGPT 3D Studio GPT presence.

events.title: Coinbase listing
events.summary: $THREE gets listed on Coinbase.

events.title: 100+ language localization ships
events.summary: three.ws ships full platform localization into 100+ languages, including right-to-left scripts.

events.title: IBM blog: "10 Best Free AI 3D Model Generators"
events.summary: IBM Community blog walks through ten three.ws features: Forge, rigged avatars, the <agent-3d> embed with lip-sync, x402 payments, MCP integration, Diorama scenes, and the /play multiplayer world.

events.title: IBM discussion: Forge walkthrough tutorial
events.summary: An IBM Community tutorial walks through three.ws Forge's text/photo/sketch-to-3D modes and its three quality tiers: Draft, Standard, and High.

events.title: NVIDIA Inception public announcement
events.summary: three.ws's NVIDIA Inception Program acceptance is publicly announced.

events.title: Jensen Huang interaction
events.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang interacts with three.ws content, amplifying the NVIDIA Inception announcement.

events.title: IBM discussion: text-prompt-to-embeddable-agent tutorial
events.summary: An IBM Community tutorial walks through going from a text prompt to a fully embeddable 3D agent: free GLB generation, mobile AR viewing, auto-rigging, and embedding via the <agent-3d> element.

events.title: NVIDIA forum: 100+ language i18n pipeline detailed
events.summary: An NVIDIA Developer Forums post details the localization pipeline behind the July 16 launch: NVIDIA NIM running Llama 3.3 70B Instruct with sentinel masking, incremental diffing, and explicit right-to-left handling.

events.title: QuickNode Startup Program (follow-up post)
events.summary: @trythreews posts a follow-up on the QuickNode Startup Program relationship first established June 9.

events.title: 500+ free 3D props library milestone
events.summary: three.ws's free 3D props library surpasses 500 items.

events.title: Named an OpenAI Select Partner
events.summary: three.ws is named an OpenAI Select Partner within the OpenAI Partner Network, alongside the free 3D Studio MCP connector that brings keyless 3D generation into ChatGPT.

events.title: AR Studio ships as an open-source package
events.summary: The multi-model AR surface behind three.ws becomes a standalone open-source package, 3d-ar-studio on npm, with a hosted demo. One script tag gives any web page a working augmented-reality viewer.

events.title: Seeker app gets its own home screen and a verified badge
events.summary: The three.ws app on Solana Seeker opens on a home screen of its own at /seeker: one tap signs you in with Seed Vault, your agents are right there, and Seeker owners can carry a verified badge.

events.title: three.ws ships as an Android app
events.summary: The signed three.ws app (v1.0.0) is published on GitHub and installs on any phone from Android 6 up: one-tap Solana wallet sign-in (Seed Vault on a Seeker), selfie to rigged 3D avatar, share-sheet intake, and agent minting on Solana mainnet from the phone. The Solana dApp Store listing is submitted the same day.

events.title: Glance: your agent as a home-screen card
events.summary: Every agent gets a live card with its name, what it did in the last 24 hours, and when it last acted. It pins to the Windows 11 widgets board, renders in a GitHub README, and prints in a terminal.

events.title: Android 1.1: the agent on the home screen
events.summary: The Android app ships a home-screen widget showing your agent, its name, and how many moves it made today, refreshing in the background about every half hour without opening the app.

events.title: CoinMarketCap article announces three.ws for Android
events.summary: A CoinMarketCap community article covers the Android launch: what the app does that the mobile site cannot, and how the Solana-native sign-in works.

events.title: Second Hugging Face article: Building 3D AI Agents End to End
events.summary: The whole stack in one piece, written to be checked: every 3D generation lane and where it runs, rigging and animation for any humanoid, the multi-model brain and its guard chain, agent payments, and every program and partner behind the platform, with a live rigged avatar embedded in the article.
